what: N cards are stood around a circle lying flat on the floor (rotateX 90°, radius screen width ÷ 3.5, 26vw back · 6.2vw down), each card counter-rotated so it always faces front, and the ring turns straight once every 12 seconds. Front and back cards overlap like a band. By cursor position the ring tilts X 70~110° · Y ±25° · Z ±5° in .8s power3. When the wheel turns it spins extra by deltaY ÷ 20 × .017rad (.5s power2), and the ring radius and perspective (100vw + 30vw × value) widen by |deltaY| ÷ 12, then return after .12s over 1.3s power2.out. Under 768 it runs at X 80° · radius 2.5× ratio with no cursor tilt.

options.tilt: Duration of following the cursor tilt (sec), default .8
options.lift: vw to lower the ring, default 1024 and up 6.2 · below that 4.5
options.ignore: No tilt when the cursor is over this selector (hero buttons etc.), default none

note: Cursor and wheel are received from the nearest [data-slot] or the whole section (it tilts anywhere in the hero). The wheel is not blocked. With reduced motion, the cards are laid out in a single row.
